metadata.tone_rationale: EvoLink's creative call, not user-specified: 'dreamlike' was picked over the other four fixed registers (elegiac/urgent/reverent/wry) because its definition — repeated motifs, non-linear, reflective — is the only one that fits a memory-driven personal-growth monologue built around one recurring visual motif planted and paid off three times. None of the five registers was designed for this content type; flag for override if it reads wrong once footage is in.

motif_hidden_engine_001.continuity_caveat: This is real stock/archival footage, not a custom-shot continuity asset — literal same-vehicle continuity across scene_001/006/011/025 is only achievable if the asset-director's retrieval pulls multiple clips from the same source video/series, or if the user supplies/records one car specifically for this motif. If retrieval returns four unrelated cars, downgrade the ambition from 'same car' continuity to 'same visual language' (similar era, color, framing) rather than failing the beat.

evolink_open_items: Scenes scene_009 through scene_025 illustrate EvoLink-placeholder script content (see script.json [[PLACEHOLDER]] markers) — replace section by section once real material exists; scene_013/scene_014 (the mentor/discovery beat) are the most fabricated and the most likely to need full replacement rather than editing.
This scene_plan now covers the full drafted arc, 0-933s — see duration_seconds_note above for why that's short of the script header's original ~1200s (20 min) target rather than padded to match.

Long-form vs. pipeline sweet spot: documentary-montage's own worked examples top out around 2-3 minutes / ~50 slots; this build uses 27 slots across 933s (~15.5 min) with deliberately longer per-slot holds (narration-paced, not tone-poem-paced) — a documented, intentional deviation, not an oversight.

production_constraints.visual_treatment: Real B-roll/stock/archival footage only — no animation, no motion graphics, no illustrated diagrams, no kinetic typography. Every scene above is type 'broll' for this reason; the only on-screen graphic in the whole piece is the single end-tag text overlay in the pipeline's mandatory closing card, per user's explicit yes to end_tag_plan.
